name: Cuarenta
description: Cuarenta is a card game commonly played with 2-6 using 52 cards. The core rules emphasize variant-specific tactical timing, legal action sequencing, and scoring control.

content.text: Cuarenta is a card game commonly played with 2-6 using 52 cards. The core rules emphasize variant-specific tactical timing, legal action sequencing, and scoring control.

Country/Region of Origin: Ecuador. Cuarenta is the national card game of Ecuador, played mostly in the highlands (Cuenca, Quito).
Time Period: Early 1900s
Historical Development: The game evolved from traditional card games in the region
Cultural Significance: Popular social and family game; official tournaments exist.

Minimum Players: 2
Maximum Players: 6
Optimal Players: 4
Partnerships: Optional

Type: Standard 52-card deck
